content.overview: Article 139A provides that where cases involving the same or substantially the same questions of law are pending before the Supreme Court and one or more High Courts or before two or more High Courts, and the Supreme Court is satisfied on its own motion or on an application that such questions are substantial questions of general importance, it may withdraw the case or cases pending before the High Court or Courts and dispose of all the cases itself. The Supreme Court may also transfer cases from one High Court to another High Court if expedient for the ends of justice.
content.glance: SC may withdraw and dispose of related cases from HCs involving substantial questions of general importance; may transfer cases between HCs for ends of justice.
content.study:
Article 139A (inserted by the 42nd Amendment, retained with modifications):
(1) Same or substantially same questions of law pending in SC and HC(s) or in two or more HCs; substantial questions of general importance → SC may withdraw HC cases and dispose of all itself.
(2) SC may transfer any case, appeal or other proceeding from one HC to another HC if expedient for the ends of justice.

Examination: withdrawal for common substantial questions; transfer between HCs; ends of justice.

sections.heading: Two powers
sections.body:
1. Withdraw HC cases involving same/substantially same substantial questions of general importance and dispose of all in SC.
2. Transfer cases/appeals/proceedings from one HC to another if expedient for ends of justice.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What powers does Article 139A confer on the Supreme Court?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 139A, where cases involving the same or substantially the same questions of law are pending before the Supreme Court and one or more High Courts or before two or more High Courts, and the questions are substantial questions of general importance, the Supreme Court may withdraw the High Court cases and dispose of all the cases itself. The Supreme Court may also transfer any case, appeal or other proceeding from one High Court to another High Court if it is expedient for the ends of justice.

examTips: Withdraw related HC cases; transfer between HCs for ends of justice.

keyTakeaways: Art 139A: transfer/withdrawal of cases for common questions or ends of justice.
